purpose: Teach: 国内外/使い分け/要員/分業/リモート/仕事場/スペック/スクロール

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、国内外の連携、強化しております、最近。
lines.en: We've been strengthening our domestic and international police partnerships lately.
lines.style: Professional, measured delivery. Even pace, no rush. Clear emphasis on 'partnerships' — the word that matters. Composed authority without coldness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、業務用と私用、しっかり、使い分けるよう、徹底中です。
lines.en: Yes. We're being thorough about keeping business and personal use strictly separate.
lines.style: Attentive, respectful nod in the voice. Steady pace. Light emphasis on 'strictly' to show diligence. Cooperative but not obsequious — colleague-to-colleague tone.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、警備要員の派遣、年末、ご相談いたします。
lines.en: We'll be consulting with you about security staff deployment for the year-end period.
lines.style: Formal, procedural tone. Even syllable weight. Slight pause before 'year-end' — administrative precision. No emotion, only clarity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内、警察協力、分業で、対応しております。
lines.en: Yes. We're handling this internally with the police through a division-of-labor approach.
lines.style: Confident, clear. Speaks with the ease of someone explaining well-established protocol. Steady tempo. Pride in the system without arrogance.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: リモート聴取、最新の手法として、活用しております。
lines.en: Remote interviewing is one of the latest methods we're utilizing.
lines.style: Informative, matter-of-fact. Voice slightly warms when naming the innovation — that small satisfaction of modernization. Measured pace. No defensiveness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察の仕事場、警察署、最近、改装されましたね。
lines.en: Yes. I noticed your police station offices have been renovated recently.
lines.style: Observational, genuine interest. Gentle uptick at the end — making conversation, not just responding. Warm familiarity without overstepping.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 防犯機器のスペック、各社、比較、慎重にしております。
lines.en: We're being careful about comparing security equipment specs from different vendors.
lines.style: Thoughtful, deliberate. Slight weight on 'careful' — emphasizing due diligence. Measured pace, no hurry. The voice of someone taking details seriously.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。被害届の電子化、スクロール、操作性、検討中です。
lines.en: Yes. We're currently reviewing the digitization of incident reports — the interface and usability.
lines.style: Focused, technical interest. Slight uptick on 'usability' — the practical concern. Even pace. Speaking as someone engaged in problem-solving, not just compliance.
